children: Thailand's Senate on Friday passed the government's 3.788 trillion baht ($114.3 billion) budget bill for the 2027 fiscal year, beginning on October 1.
The bill will need royal approval before it can be enacted.
The 2027 budget plan projects a 0.2% rise in spending and an 8.4% drop in the deficit to 788 billion baht compared with the current fiscal year.
Here are the proposed allocations, according to documents published by Thailand's Budget Bureau.
Social opportunity & equality: 960.9 billion baht, 25.4% of total spending.
Public administration reform: 676.3 billion baht, or 17.9% of the total.
Reserved government operating items: 646.5 billion baht, or 17.1%.
Human resource development (education, public health): 611.2 billion baht, or 16.1%.
Competitiveness (transport, logistics, agriculture): 348.4 billion baht, or 9.2%.
